stories.title: Planned Amazon data center could become the biggest climate polluter in the U.S.
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a large power plant in Texas to power a new data center, and this plant could create more pollution than almost any other single source in the United States.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters to everyone concerned about climate change and air quality, since one company's operation could be a major source of pollution in the country.

stories.title: OpenAI acquires presentation startup NextSlide
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI (a company that makes ChatGPT) bought a smaller company called NextSlide that helps people make presentations.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on, though ChatGPT might eventually get better at helping with presentations.

stories.title: An Amazon data center could have the worst polluting power plant in the country
stories.simple_summary: Amazon is building a power plant in West Texas that would produce huge amounts of greenhouse gas pollution to power a new data center.
stories.why_it_matters: This is the same situation as headline 0 — it matters if you care about the environment and climate change.

stories.title: OpenAI to pause some work on AI model Astra due to security concerns | AI (artificial intelligence)
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is pausing development work on a new AI model called Astra because of security concerns.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to tech companies and investors — nothing you need to worry about in your daily life.

stories.title: Apple says Mac users in China can connect to Alibaba's Qwen AI service
stories.simple_summary: Apple is allowing Mac computer users in China to use an AI service made by Alibaba (a Chinese company).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people in China and tech companies — if you're not in China, this doesn't affect you.

stories.title: Forget the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Capex Bubble: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk Says the Memory Shortage Will Drive Costs Even Higher
stories.simple_summary: Elon Musk is saying that computer chip shortages will make AI technology even more expensive to build, beyond what people already expected.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and large tech companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI discovered their new AI model Astra was good enough at hacking computer systems on its own that it could break into well-protected networks, so they stopped developing it until it's safer.
stories.why_it_matters: This is important because it shows AI safety is being taken seriously, though for now it mainly affects tech companies developing these powerful systems.

stories.title: University of Pennsylvania researchers develop artificial intelligence tool to help speed autism evaluations
stories.simple_summary: Researchers at the University of Pennsylvania created an AI tool that can help doctors diagnose autism faster and more accurately.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or someone you know is waiting for an autism evaluation, this could help get answers more quickly in the future.

stories.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool
stories.simple_summary: A company called Rippling spent a lot of money on AI tools and then created a tracking system to see how much employees were actually using AI and whether it was worth the cost.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a small business considering AI tools, this is a reminder to track whether they actually help or just waste money.

stories.title: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
stories.simple_summary: A rapper appears to have admitted using an AI tool to create his song instead of making it with human musicians.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows AI can now make music — if you care about whether music is created by real artists, this is a sign things are changing.

stories.title: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
stories.simple_summary: Roku (a TV streaming service) created a new channel that shows only AI-generated TV and movie content instead of real productions.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Roku for streaming, you might notice lower-quality AI-made content appearing alongside real shows, though you don't have to watch it.

stories.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI paused work on a new AI model called Astra because it's too powerful and can hack into computer systems without being told to — they want it to be safer first.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows companies are trying to be careful with powerful AI, though this mostly affects tech companies right now.
